commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Standardize CORTEX_API_KEY environment variable naming

- Change docker-compose.yml to use CORTEX_API_KEY instead of Cortex__ApiKey
- Update .env.template to use standard CORTEX_API_KEY format
- .NET app already has fallback to read CORTEX_API_KEY directly
- PowerShell scripts already expect CORTEX_API_KEY

This eliminates confusion between .NET config format (Cortex__ApiKey)
and standard environment variable convention (CORTEX_API_KEY).
